overall_goal: Add and stir the dried and chopped mushrooms into the frying pan

goals.description: Pour the dried mushrooms from the glass jug into the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person picks up the glass jug, pours the mushrooms into the pan, taps the spatula, and sets the jug down.

goals.description: Add the chopped mushrooms from the cardboard trays into the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person empties two cardboard trays of chopped mushrooms into the pan, shaking them and removing any remaining bits.

goals.description: Stir the mushrooms into the frying pan mixture
goals.rationale: The person picks up the spatula, stirs the ingredients in the pan, and taps the spatula to clean it off.
